package vparquet4

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb"
	cv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/common/v1"
	tv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/trace/v1"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/traceql"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/backend"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/encoding/common"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"testing"
)

func TestPulseDiscoveryScopes(t *testing.T) {
	integer := func(k string, v int64) *cv.KeyValue {
		return &cv.KeyValue{Key: k, Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_IntValue{IntValue: v}}}
	}
	boolean := func(k string, v bool) *cv.KeyValue {
		return &cv.KeyValue{Key: k, Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_BoolValue{BoolValue: v}}}
	}
	opaque := func() *cv.KeyValue {
		return &cv.KeyValue{Key: "opaque", Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_BytesValue{BytesValue: []byte("abc")}}}
	}
	a := batch(1, "worker", "api", 1, 0, 10_000_000_000, 11_000_000_000)
	b := batch(2, "frontend", "rpc", 1, 0, 20_000_000_000, 21_000_000_000)
	for i, r := range []*tv.ResourceSpans{a, b} {
		r.Resource.Attributes = append(r.Resource.Attributes, value("shared", "resource"))
		r.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].Attributes = []*cv.KeyValue{value("request.kind", []string{"api", "rpc"}[i]), value("shared", "span")}
	}
	a.ScopeSpans[0].Scope = &cv.InstrumentationScope{Name: "worker-sdk", Version: "v1", Attributes: []*cv.KeyValue{value("shared", "instrumentation"), value("channel", "api"), integer("count", -9223372036854775808), boolean("enabled", false), value("empty", ""), opaque()}}
	b.ScopeSpans[0].Scope = &cv.InstrumentationScope{Name: "frontend-sdk", Version: "v2", Attributes: []*cv.KeyValue{value("shared", "instrumentation"), value("channel", "rpc"), integer("count", 9223372036854775807), boolean("enabled", true)}}
	a.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].Events = []*tv.Span_Event{
		{Name: "intrinsic-start-name", TimeUnixNano: 10_000_000_001, Attributes: []*cv.KeyValue{value("shared", "event"), value("phase", "first"), integer("count", -9223372036854775808), boolean("enabled", false), value("empty", ""), opaque()}},
		{Name: "intrinsic-end-name", TimeUnixNano: 10_000_000_002, Attributes: []*cv.KeyValue{value("phase", "second"), integer("count", 7), boolean("enabled", true)}},
	}
	b.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].Events = []*tv.Span_Event{{Name: "other-event", TimeUnixNano: 20_000_000_001, Attributes: []*cv.KeyValue{value("shared", "event"), value("phase", "frontend"), integer("count", 9223372036854775807)}}}
	link := func(id byte, attrs []*cv.KeyValue) *tv.Span_Link {
		tid := make([]byte, 16)
		tid[15] = id
		sid := make([]byte, 8)
		sid[7] = id
		return &tv.Span_Link{TraceId: tid, SpanId: sid, Attributes: attrs}
	}
	a.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].Links = []*tv.Span_Link{link(3, []*cv.KeyValue{value("shared", "link"), value("phase", "first"), integer("count", -9223372036854775808), boolean("enabled", false), value("empty", ""), opaque()}), link(4, []*cv.KeyValue{value("phase", "second"), integer("count", 7), boolean("enabled", true)})}
	b.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].Links = []*tv.Span_Link{link(5, []*cv.KeyValue{value("shared", "link"), value("phase", "frontend"), integer("count", 9223372036854775807)})}
	all := &tempopb.Trace{ResourceSpans: []*tv.ResourceSpans{a, b}}
	var rows []*Trace
	for _, r := range all.ResourceSpans {
		tr := &tempopb.Trace{ResourceSpans: []*tv.ResourceSpans{r}}
		row, _ := traceToParquet(&backend.BlockMeta{}, r.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].TraceId, tr, nil)
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	block := makeBackendBlockWithTraces(t, rows)
	ctx := context.Background()
	opts := common.DefaultSearchOptions()
	engine := traceql.NewEngine()
	type Case struct {
		Scope    string      `json:"scope"`
		Key      string      `json:"key"`
		Query    string      `json:"query"`
		Response interface{} `json:"response"`
	}
	cases := []Case{}
	for _, scope := range []string{"resource", "span", "instrumentation", "event", "link"} {
		set := map[string]bool{}
		if err := block.SearchTags(ctx, traceql.AttributeScopeFromString(scope), func(k string, _ traceql.AttributeScope) { set[k] = true }, func(uint64) {}, opts); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		names := []string{}
		for k := range set {
			names = append(names, k)
		}
		sort.Strings(names)
		cases = append(cases, Case{Scope: scope, Response: map[string]any{"scopes": []any{map[string]any{"name": scope, "tags": names}}}})
		keys := []string{"shared"}
		if scope != "resource" && scope != "span" {
			keys = append(keys, "count", "enabled", "empty", "absent")
			if scope == "instrumentation" {
				keys = append(keys, "channel", "name")
			} else {
				keys = append(keys, "phase")
			}
		}
		for _, key := range keys {
			for _, q := range []string{"", `{resource.service.name="worker" && span.request.kind="api"}`, `{resource.service.name="absent"}`} {
				tag, err := traceql.ParseIdentifier(scope + "." + key)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				vals := map[tempopb.TagValue]bool{}
				collect := traceql.MakeCollectTagValueFunc(func(v tempopb.TagValue) bool { vals[v] = true; return false })
				if q == "" {
					err = block.SearchTagValuesV2(ctx, tag, collect, func(uint64) {}, opts)
				} else {
					fetcher := traceql.NewTagValuesFetcherWrapper(func(ctx context.Context, req traceql.FetchTagValuesRequest, cb traceql.FetchTagValuesCallback) error {
						return block.FetchTagValues(ctx, req, cb, func(uint64) {}, opts)
					})
					err = engine.ExecuteTagValues(ctx, tag, q, collect, fetcher)
				}
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				values := []tempopb.TagValue{}
				for v := range vals {
					values = append(values, v)
				}
				sort.Slice(values, func(i, j int) bool {
					if values[i].Type == values[j].Type {
						return values[i].Value < values[j].Value
					}
					return values[i].Type < values[j].Type
				})
				cases = append(cases, Case{scope, key, q, map[string]any{"tagValues": values}})
			}
		}
	}
	// Optional one-off actual public protobuf consumer; ordinary replay has no Go dependency.
	for i, c := range cases {
		wire, err := os.ReadFile(fmt.Sprintf("/tmp/pulse-tempo-scopes/result-%03d.protobuf", i))
		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
			continue
		}
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var got, want proto.Message
		if c.Key == "" {
			got = &tempopb.SearchTagsV2Response{}
			want = &tempopb.SearchTagsV2Response{}
		} else {
			got = &tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{}
			want = &tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{}
		}
		raw, _ := json.Marshal(c.Response)
		if err = json.Unmarshal(raw, want); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err = proto.Unmarshal(wire, got); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		actual, _ := json.Marshal(got)
		expected, _ := json.Marshal(want)
		if string(actual) != string(expected) {
			t.Fatalf("protobuf case %d: %s vs %s", i, actual, expected)
		}
	}
	dir := "/tmp/pulse-tempo-scopes"
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	raw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(cases, "", "  ")
	if err := os.WriteFile(dir+"/oracle.json", append(raw, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	wire, err := proto.Marshal(all)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile(dir+"/input.protobuf", wire, 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
